AddRows.description: Adds the new rows to the current table.

params.description: Count of rows to be added.
params.name: nCount

params.description: Specifies if the rows will be added before or after the current row.
params.name: isBefore

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

AddRows.signature: AddRows(nCount: number, isBefore?: boolean): ApiTable | null

Clear.description: Clears the content from the current row.

returns.description: returns false if parent table doesn't exist.

GetCell.description: Returns a cell by its position.

params.description: The cell index in the current row.
params.name: cellIndex

GetCellsCount.description: Returns a number of cells in the current row.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTableRow class.

GetHeight.description: Returns the height of the current table row.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal id of the current table row.

GetNext.description: Returns the next row if exists.

returns.description: returns null if row is last.

GetParentTable.description: Returns the parent table of the current row.

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

GetPrevious.description: Returns the previous row if exists.

returns.description: returns null if row is first.

MergeCells.description: Merges the cells in the current row.

returns.description: return false if parent table doesn't exist.

Search.description: Searches for a scope of a table row object. The search results are a collection of ApiRange objects.

params.description: Search string, or a regular expression to match. When a RegExp is passed, the isMatchCase parameter is ignored (control case sensitivity with the "i" flag instead).
params.name: sText

Search.signature: Search(sText: string | RegExp, isMatchCase: boolean): ApiRange[]

SetBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color to all cells in the current table row.

params.description: If not passed, the background color will be cleared.
params.name: color

SetHeight.description: Sets the height to the current table row within the current table.

params.description: The rule to apply the height value to the current table row or ignore it. Use the `"atLeast"` value to enable the `SetHeight` method use.
params.name: sHRule

params.description: The height for the current table row measured in twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch). This value will be ignored if `sHRule="auto"`.
params.name: nValue

SetRowPr.description: Sets the properties to the current table row.

SetTableHeader.description:
Specifies that the current table row will be repeated at the top of each new page 
wherever this table is displayed. This gives this table row the behavior of a 'header' row on 
each of these pages. This element can be applied to any number of rows at the top of the 
table structure in order to generate multi-row table headers.

params.description: The true value means that the current table row will be repeated at the top of each new page.
params.name: isHeader

SetTextPr.description: Sets the text properties to the current row.

params.description: The text properties that will be set to the current row.
params.name: oTextPr

returns.description: returns false if parent table doesn't exist or param is invalid.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiTableRowPr object into the JSON object.
